style.backgroundSystem: three recurring fields only: a matte deep green studio wall for the display hero, a pale sage/off-white flat field for infographic screens, and a graphite dark field for spec and macro screens; never photographic street clutter except the single pain-point panel
style.direction: premium showroom-tech ecommerce with a home-window display hero and a flat infographic body
style.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms centred on solid green discs with one brass highlight wedge; rounded speech-bubble cards with a single pointed tail; wireframe sine-wave line mesh as the only decorative graphic
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused key from the upper left, low-contrast wrap shadows, visible contact shadow grounding every object, controlled specular rim on the metal rim band and matte housing, 5000-5600K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech-ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine green #0F5A4A, graphite black #17181A, pale sage #E4E6DC and off-white #F7F5F0 as base fields, with brass gold #C9A24C as the single accent and one restrained circuit blue #3D7FB8 allowed only on macro technology screens; neutral tone; backgrounds limited to a matte green studio wall, a pale flat infographic field and a graphite dark field; soft diffused key light from the upper left, low-contrast wrap shadows, always a real contact shadow, controlled specular rim on metal rims and matte housings, 5000-5600K; one modern geometric sans-serif family, thin-line pictograms on solid green discs with a brass highlight wedge, rounded speech-bubble cards with one pointed tail, hairline vertical rules and small kicker labels, wireframe sine-wave line mesh as the only decorative graphic; stable product scale and centring inside each band, product presentation angle kept consistent, label placement unchanged; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks or QR codes.
noDrift: no source brand marks, wordmarks, store badges or QR codes
